+      fixture.source_selection.representative_basis === 'real_all_3530_row'

+      fixtures.filter((fixture) => fixture.validation.status === 'pass').length,
+    schema_invalid_fixture_count:
+      fixtures.filter((fixture) => fixture.validation.status !== 'pass').length,
+    source_image_primary_fixture_count: fixtures.filter((fixture) => (
+      /source|image|screenshot/u.test(String(fixture.payload?.primary_display_mode)) ||
+      ['source_asset', 'source_image', 'source_ms_screenshot', 'official_ms_image']
+        .includes(arrayFrom(fixture.payload?.learner_display_order)[0])

+    blocked_source_image_student_display_allowed_count: fixtures.filter((fixture) => (
+      blockedSourceIds.has(fixture.fixture_id) &&
+      (
+        fixture.payload?.source_asset?.student_display_allowed === true ||

+        fixture.payload?.display_gates?.evidence_drawer_student_display_allowed === true

+}
+
+function buildFixturesArtifact({ paths, generatedAt, fixtures, summary, sourceArtifactsList }) {
+  const base = {
+    schema_version: FIXTURES_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+    payload_schema_version: PAYLOAD_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+    policy_version: POLICY_VERSION,
+    generated_at: generatedAt,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    issue: ISSUE,
+    parent_issue: PARENT_ISSUE,
+    depends_on_issues: [...DEPENDS_ON_ISSUES],
+    subject_code: SUBJECT_CODE,
+    objective:
+      'Provide frontend-facing PostAttemptReviewPayload fixtures for post-attempt review UI work without implementing frontend UI.',
+    output_artifacts: {
+      fixtures: paths.fixturesOut,
+      manifest: paths.manifestOut,
+      validator: paths.validatorOut,
+      readback: paths.readbackOut,

+    source_artifacts: sourceArtifactsList,
+    frontend_ui_integration_performed: false,

+      synthetic_frontend_projection_allowed_when_native_state_absent: true,
+      projection_marker_required: true,

+    native_absence_notes: [
+      'The checked-in all-3530 read model currently has real rows for provisional structured review and unavailable fallback states.',
+      'Accepted structured, source screenshot visibility, rights-blocked, rights-unconfirmed image, quality-blocked image, hybrid, and no-released-scoring-authority states are synthetic frontend projections backed by upstream policy/posture fixtures.',
+    ],
+    upstream_validation: {
+      all_3530_validator_status: null,
+      feedback_wording_policy_validator_status: null,
+    },
+    summary,
+    fixtures,
+  };
+  return {
+    ...base,
+    content_hash: {
+      algorithm: 'sha256',
+      value: sha256Value({
+        schema_version: base.schema_version,
+        summary,
+        fixtures: fixtures.map((fixture) => ({
+          fixture_id: fixture.fixture_id,
+          representative_basis: fixture.source_selection.representative_basis,
+          payload: fixture.payload,
+          expected_ui_behavior: fixture.expected_ui_behavior,
+          validation: fixture.validation,
+        })),
+      }),
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+function buildManifest({ paths, generatedAt, fixturesArtifact }) {
+  const fixtureManifest = fixturesArtifact.fixtures.map((fixture) => ({
+    fixture_id: fixture.fixture_id,
+    fixture_state: fixture.fixture_state,
+    required_state: fixture.required_state,
+    representative_basis: fixture.source_selection.representative_basis,
+    source_row_id: fixture.source_selection.source_row_id,
+    read_model_row_index: fixture.source_selection.read_model_row_index,
+    source_derivation_kind: fixture.source_selection.source_derivation_kind,
+    derived_from_source_payload: fixture.source_selection.derived_from_source_payload,
+    derivation_reason: fixture.source_selection.derivation_reason,
+    real_all_3530_match_count: fixture.source_selection.real_all_3530_match_count,
+    payload_validation_status: fixture.validation.status,
+    primary_display_mode: fixture.payload?.primary_display_mode ?? null,
+    evidence_drawer_mode: fixture.payload?.evidence_drawer_mode ?? null,
+    scoring_posture: fixture.payload?.scoring_posture ?? null,
+    source_image_visibility: fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.source_image_visibility ?? null,
+    source_asset_student_display_allowed:
+      fixture.payload?.source_asset?.student_display_allowed === true,
+    official_ms_image_student_display_allowed:
+      fixture.payload?.display_gates?.official_ms_image_student_display_allowed === true,
+    awarded_mark_wording_allowed:
+      fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.awarded_mark_wording_allowed === true,
+    source_artifact_refs: fixture.source_selection.source_artifact_refs,
+    policy_notes: fixture.policy_notes,
+    expected_ui_policy_notes: fixture.expected_ui_policy_notes,
+    expected_ui_behavior: fixture.expected_ui_behavior,
+  }));
+  const base = {
+    schema_version: MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+    generated_at: generatedAt,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    issue: ISSUE,
+    parent_issue: PARENT_ISSUE,
+    depends_on_issues: [...DEPENDS_ON_ISSUES],
+    subject_code: SUBJECT_CODE,
+    manifest_status: 'ready',
+    output_artifacts: {
+      fixtures: paths.fixturesOut,
+      manifest: paths.manifestOut,
+      validator: paths.validatorOut,
+      readback: paths.readbackOut,
+    },
+    source_artifacts: fixturesArtifact.source_artifacts,
+    summary: fixturesArtifact.summary,
+    fixture_manifest: fixtureManifest,
+    no_frontend_ui_integration_claim: true,
+  };
+  return {
+    ...base,
+    content_hash: {
+      algorithm: 'sha256',
+      value: sha256Value({
+        schema_version: base.schema_version,
+        fixture_manifest: base.fixture_manifest,
+        summary: base.summary,
+      }),
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+function check(status, id, details = {}) {
+  return { id, status: status === true ? 'pass' : 'fail', ...details };
+}
+
+function fixtureById(fixtures, fixtureId) {
+  return arrayFrom(fixtures?.fixtures).find((item) => item?.fixture_id === fixtureId) ?? null;
+}
+
+function manifestEntryById(manifest, fixtureId) {
+  return arrayFrom(manifest?.fixture_manifest).find((item) => item?.fixture_id === fixtureId) ?? null;
+}
+
+function primaryDisplayLooksSourceImage(payload) {
+  return /source|image|screenshot|official_ms_image|asset/u.test(
+    String(payload?.primary_display_mode),
+  );
+}
+
+function sourceAssetFirst(payload) {
+  return ['source_asset', 'source_image', 'source_ms_screenshot', 'official_ms_image']
+    .includes(arrayFrom(payload?.learner_display_order)[0]);
+}
+
+function candidateScreenshotsHidden(fixtures, errors) {
+  const fixture = fixtureById(fixtures, 'candidate_screenshot_hidden');

+    fixture.payload.source_asset?.review_status === 'candidate_only' &&
+    fixture.payload.source_asset?.student_display_allowed === false &&
+    fixture.payload.display_gates?.official_ms_image_student_display_allowed === false &&
+    fixture.payload.display_gates?.evidence_drawer_student_display_allowed === false &&
+    fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.source_image_visibility === 'hidden';
+  if (!ok) errors.push('candidate_screenshot_hidden:candidate_screenshot_must_be_hidden');
+  return ok;
+}
+
+function rightsAndQualityBlockedImagesHidden(fixtures, errors) {
+  let ok = true;

+    'rights_unconfirmed_source_image_hidden',
+    'rights_blocked_source_image_hidden',
+    'quality_blocked_source_image_hidden',
+  ]) {

+      fixture.payload.source_asset?.exists === true &&
+      fixture.payload.source_asset?.student_display_allowed === false &&
+      fixture.payload.display_gates?.official_ms_image_student_display_allowed === false &&
+      fixture.payload.display_gates?.evidence_drawer_student_display_allowed === false &&
+      fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.source_image_visibility === 'hidden';
+    if (!hidden) {
+      ok = false;
+      errors.push(`${fixtureId}:blocked_source_image_must_be_hidden`);
+    }
+  }
+  return ok;
+}
+
+function noAwardedMarkWordingWithoutAuthority(fixtures, errors) {
+  let ok = true;
+  for (const fixture of arrayFrom(fixtures?.fixtures)) {
+    if (
+      fixture?.expected_ui_behavior?.awarded_mark_wording_allowed === true &&
+      !hasReleasedScoringAuthority(fixture.payload)

+}
+
+function acceptedScreenshotWithoutStructuredUsesFallback(fixtures, errors) {
+  const fixture = fixtureById(fixtures, 'accepted_source_screenshot_missing_structured_marks');
+  const payload = fixture?.payload;
+  const ok = isRecord(payload) &&
+    sourceImageVisibleInEvidenceDrawer(payload) &&
+    payload.structured_mark_point_posture?.status === 'missing' &&
+    ['fallback_explanation', 'unavailable'].includes(payload.primary_display_mode) &&
+    payload.display_gates?.structured_feedback_student_display_allowed === false &&
+    payload.point_judgement_allowed === false &&
+    payload.authoritative_score_allowed === false &&
+    fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.source_image_visibility === 'evidence_drawer_only';
+  if (!ok) {
+    errors.push(
+      'accepted_source_screenshot_missing_structured_marks:accepted_source_screenshot_without_structured_must_use_fallback_primary',
+    );
+  }
+  return ok;
+}
+
+function hybridKeepsStructuredPrimary(fixtures, errors) {
+  const fixture = fixtureById(fixtures, 'hybrid_structured_with_citation');
+  const payload = fixture?.payload;
+  const ok = isRecord(payload) &&
+    payload.primary_display_mode === 'hybrid_structured_with_citation' &&
+    arrayFrom(payload.learner_display_order)[0] === 'structured_feedback' &&
+    arrayFrom(payload.evidence_refs?.citations).length > 0 &&
+    sourceImageVisibleInEvidenceDrawer(payload) &&
+    fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.source_image_visibility === 'evidence_drawer_only';
+  if (!ok) {
+    errors.push('hybrid_structured_with_citation:structured_primary_or_evidence_drawer_missing');
+  }
+  return ok;
+}
+
+function expectedUiBehaviorNotesComplete(fixtures) {
+  return arrayFrom(fixtures?.fixtures).every((fixture) => (
+    isRecord(fixture?.expected_ui_behavior) &&
+    isString(fixture.expected_ui_behavior.primary_mode) &&
+    isString(fixture.expected_ui_behavior.evidence_drawer) &&
+    isString(fixture.expected_ui_behavior.scoring_posture) &&
+    isString(fixture.expected_ui_behavior.source_image_visibility) &&
+    Object.hasOwn(fixture.expected_ui_behavior, 'fallback_wording') &&
+    typeof fixture.expected_ui_behavior.awarded_mark_wording_allowed === 'boolean' &&
+    arrayFrom(fixture.expected_ui_policy_notes).length > 0 &&
+    arrayFrom(fixture.policy_notes).length > 0
+  ));
+}
+
+function manifestComplete(manifest) {
+  return isRecord(manifest) &&
+    manifest.no_frontend_ui_integration_claim === true &&
+    REQUIRED_FIXTURE_IDS.every((fixtureId) => {
+      const entry = manifestEntryById(manifest, fixtureId);
+      return isRecord(entry) &&
+        ['real_all_3530_row', 'synthetic_frontend_projection'].includes(entry.representative_basis) &&
+        Array.isArray(entry.source_artifact_refs) &&
+        entry.source_artifact_refs.length > 0 &&
+        Array.isArray(entry.policy_notes) &&
+        entry.policy_notes.length > 0 &&
+        Array.isArray(entry.expected_ui_policy_notes) &&
+        entry.expected_ui_policy_notes.length > 0;
+    });
+}
+
+function everyFixtureHasRealRowOrProjectionMarker(fixtures) {
+  return arrayFrom(fixtures?.fixtures).every((fixture) => {
+    const basis = fixture?.source_selection?.representative_basis;
+    if (basis === 'real_all_3530_row') {
+      return isString(fixture.source_selection.source_row_id) &&
+        Number.isInteger(fixture.source_selection.read_model_row_index) &&
+        fixture.source_selection.real_all_3530_match_count > 0;
+    }
+    return basis === 'synthetic_frontend_projection' &&
+      isString(fixture.source_selection.derivation_reason) &&
+      fixture.source_selection.real_all_3530_match_count === 0;
+  });
+}
+
+function upstreamArtifactsPassing({ fixtures, all3530ReadModel, feedbackPolicy }) {
+  return fixtures?.upstream_validation?.all_3530_validator_status === 'pass' &&
+    fixtures?.upstream_validation?.feedback_wording_policy_validator_status === 'pass' &&
+    all3530ReadModel?.summary?.total_post_attempt_review_payload_row_count === 3530 &&
+    all3530ReadModel?.summary?.missing_post_attempt_review_payload_row_count === 0 &&
+    Array.isArray(all3530ReadModel?.rows) &&
+    feedbackPolicy?.issue === 1435 &&
+    Array.isArray(feedbackPolicy?.fixtures);
+}
+
+export function validatePostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendFixtures({
+  fixtures,
+  manifest,
+  schema,
+  boundary,
+  all3530ReadModel,
+  feedbackPolicy,
+} = {}) {
+  const errors = [];
+  const fixtureList = arrayFrom(fixtures?.fixtures);
+  if (!isRecord(fixtures)) errors.push('fixtures_required');
+  if (!isRecord(manifest)) errors.push('manifest_required');
+  if (!isRecord(schema)) errors.push('schema_required');
+  if (!isRecord(boundary)) errors.push('boundary_required');
+
+  const fixtureIds = fixtureList.map((fixture) => fixture.fixture_id);
+  const requiredStatesPresent =
+    REQUIRED_FIXTURE_IDS.every((fixtureId) => fixtureIds.includes(fixtureId)) &&
+    fixtureIds.length === REQUIRED_FIXTURE_IDS.length;
+  if (!requiredStatesPresent) errors.push('required_frontend_fixture_states_missing');
+
+  const payloadValidations = fixtureList.map((fixture) => validatePostAttemptReviewPayload({
+    schema,
+    payload: fixture?.payload,
+    boundary,
+    fixtureId: fixture?.fixture_id ?? 'unknown',
+  }));
+  for (const validation of payloadValidations) {
+    for (const error of validation.errors) errors.push(error);
+  }
+  const allPayloadsValidate = payloadValidations.every((validation) => validation.status === 'pass');
+
+  const primaryDisplayNeverSourceImage = fixtureList.every((fixture) => (
+    !primaryDisplayLooksSourceImage(fixture?.payload)
+  ));
+  if (!primaryDisplayNeverSourceImage) errors.push('source_image_primary_display_present');
+
+  const screenshotNotPrimary = fixtureList.every((fixture) => (
+    !primaryDisplayLooksSourceImage(fixture?.payload) && !sourceAssetFirst(fixture?.payload)
+  ));
+  if (!screenshotNotPrimary) errors.push('source_screenshot_primary_or_first_display_present');
+
+  const candidateHidden = candidateScreenshotsHidden(fixtures, errors);
+  const blockedHidden = rightsAndQualityBlockedImagesHidden(fixtures, errors);
+  const noAwardedMarkWithoutAuthority =
+    noAwardedMarkWordingWithoutAuthority(fixtures, errors);
+  const acceptedSourceFallback =
+    acceptedScreenshotWithoutStructuredUsesFallback(fixtures, errors);
+  const hybridStructuredPrimary = hybridKeepsStructuredPrimary(fixtures, errors);
+  const behaviorNotesComplete = expectedUiBehaviorNotesComplete(fixtures);
+  const manifestHasRefs = manifestComplete(manifest);
+  const rowOrProjectionMarker = everyFixtureHasRealRowOrProjectionMarker(fixtures);
+  const frontendUiNotPerformed =
+    fixtures?.frontend_ui_integration_performed === false &&
+    fixtures?.full_frontend_ui_implemented === false &&
+    manifest?.no_frontend_ui_integration_claim === true;
+  const upstreamPassing = upstreamArtifactsPassing({
+    fixtures,
+    all3530ReadModel,
+    feedbackPolicy,
+  });
+
+  const checksById = {
+    accepted_source_screenshot_without_structured_uses_fallback_primary:
+      acceptedSourceFallback,
+    all_fixture_payloads_validate_against_post_attempt_review_payload_schema:
+      allPayloadsValidate,
+    candidate_screenshots_hidden: candidateHidden,
+    every_fixture_has_real_row_or_projection_marker: rowOrProjectionMarker,
+    expected_ui_behavior_notes_complete: behaviorNotesComplete,
+    frontend_ui_integration_not_performed: frontendUiNotPerformed,
+    hybrid_keeps_structured_primary_with_optional_evidence_drawer: hybridStructuredPrimary,
+    manifest_has_source_refs_policy_notes_and_projection_markers: manifestHasRefs,
+    no_awarded_mark_wording_without_released_scoring_authority:
+      noAwardedMarkWithoutAuthority,
+    primary_display_never_source_image_only: primaryDisplayNeverSourceImage,
+    required_frontend_fixture_states_present: requiredStatesPresent,
+    rights_and_quality_blocked_images_hidden: blockedHidden,
+    screenshot_not_primary_by_default: screenshotNotPrimary,
+    upstream_artifacts_passing: upstreamPassing,
+  };
+  const checks = VALIDATOR_CHECK_IDS.map((id) => check(checksById[id], id));
+  for (const failed of checks.filter((item) => item.status !== 'pass')) {
+    errors.push(`check_failed:${failed.id}`);
+  }
+
+  const uniqueErrors = [...new Set(errors)];
+  const validatorStatus = uniqueErrors.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail';
+  const base = {
+    schema_version: VALIDATOR_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+    generated_at: fixtures?.generated_at ?? DEFAULT_GENERATED_AT,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    issue: ISSUE,
+    parent_issue: PARENT_ISSUE,
+    depends_on_issues: [...DEPENDS_ON_ISSUES],
+    validator_status: validatorStatus,
+    fixtures_path: fixtures?.output_artifacts?.fixtures ?? DEFAULT_PATHS.fixturesOut,
+    manifest_path: manifest?.output_artifacts?.manifest ?? DEFAULT_PATHS.manifestOut,
+    summary: {
+      validation_status: validatorStatus,
+      fixture_count: fixtureList.length,
+      check_count: checks.length,
+      check_pass_count: checks.filter((item) => item.status === 'pass').length,
+      check_fail_count: checks.filter((item) => item.status !== 'pass').length,
+      schema_valid_fixture_count:
+        payloadValidations.filter((validation) => validation.status === 'pass').length,
+      schema_invalid_fixture_count:
+        payloadValidations.filter((validation) => validation.status !== 'pass').length,
+      real_all_3530_row_fixture_count:
+        fixtureList.filter((fixture) => (
+          fixture?.source_selection?.representative_basis === 'real_all_3530_row'
+        )).length,
+      synthetic_frontend_projection_fixture_count:
+        fixtureList.filter((fixture) => (
+          fixture?.source_selection?.representative_basis === 'synthetic_frontend_projection'
+        )).length,
+      source_image_primary_fixture_count:
+        fixtures?.summary?.source_image_primary_fixture_count ?? null,
+      blocked_source_image_student_display_allowed_count:
+        fixtures?.summary?.blocked_source_image_student_display_allowed_count ?? null,
+      frontend_ui_integration_performed:
+        fixtures?.frontend_ui_integration_performed === true,
+    },
+    checks,
+    errors: uniqueErrors,
+  };
+  return {
+    ...base,
+    content_hash: {
+      algorithm: 'sha256',
+      value: sha256Value({
+        schema_version: base.schema_version,
+        validator_status: base.validator_status,
+        summary: base.summary,
+        checks: base.checks,
+        errors: base.errors,
+      }),
+    },
+  };
+}

+function buildReadback({ fixtures, manifest, validatorResult }) {
+  const summary = fixtures.summary;
+  return `# PostAttemptReviewPayload Frontend Fixtures Readback
+
+Issue: #${ISSUE}
+Parent: #${PARENT_ISSUE}

+## Fixture Coverage
+
+- fixture_count: \`${summary.fixture_count}\`
+- required_state_count: \`${summary.required_state_count}\`
+- real_all_3530_row_fixture_count: \`${summary.real_all_3530_row_fixture_count}\`
+- synthetic_frontend_projection_fixture_count: \`${summary.synthetic_frontend_projection_fixture_count}\`
+- schema_valid_fixture_count: \`${summary.schema_valid_fixture_count}\`
+- source_screenshot_evidence_drawer_fixture_count: \`${summary.source_screenshot_evidence_drawer_fixture_count}\`
+- source_image_primary_fixture_count: \`${summary.source_image_primary_fixture_count}\`
+- blocked_source_image_student_display_allowed_count: \`${summary.blocked_source_image_student_display_allowed_count}\`
+
+## UI Policy
+
+Primary display is structured/native, hybrid structured-with-citation, or fallback/unavailable. Source screenshots are never primary by default; accepted screenshots appear only as optional evidence drawer content. Candidate, rights-unconfirmed, rights-blocked, and quality-blocked screenshots are hidden. Accepted structured marks without released scoring authority use self-assessment wording and do not permit awarded-mark wording.
+
+## Manifest
+
+- no_frontend_ui_integration_claim: \`${manifest.no_frontend_ui_integration_claim}\`
+- fixture_manifest_count: \`${arrayFrom(manifest.fixture_manifest).length}\`
+
+## Validator
+
+${validatorResult.checks.map((checkItem) => `- ${checkItem.id}: ${checkItem.status}`).join('\n')}
+`;
+}

+export function buildPostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendFixtures(options = {}) {
+  const root = rootFromOptions(options);
+  const paths = pathsFromOptions(options);
+  const generatedAt = generatedAtFromOptions(options);
+  const inputs = options.inputs && typeof options.inputs === 'object'
+    ? options.inputs

+    inputs.adapterResult?.candidates?.source_artifacts,

+    root,
+    paths,
+    selection,
+    inputs,
+    generatedFromHashes,
+  }));
+  const sourceArtifactsList = sourceArtifacts(root, paths);
+  const summary = summarizeFixtures(fixtures);
+  let fixturesArtifact = buildFixturesArtifact({
+    paths,
+    generatedAt,
+    fixtures,
+    summary,
+    sourceArtifactsList,

+      feedback_wording_policy_validator_status:
+        inputs.feedbackPolicyValidator?.validator_status ?? null,

+  const manifest = buildManifest({ paths, generatedAt, fixturesArtifact });
+  const validatorResult = validatePostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendFixtures({
+    fixtures: fixturesArtifact,
+    manifest,
+    schema: inputs.schema,
+    boundary: inputs.boundary,
+    all3530ReadModel: inputs.all3530ReadModel,

+  });

+function withOptionalSourceScreenshotEvidence(sourcePayload) {
+  const payload = cloneJson(sourcePayload);

+    evidence_drawer_student_display_allowed: true,
+  };
+  payload.evidence_refs = {
+    ...payload.evidence_refs,
+    source_asset_ref: 'source-ms-screenshot:hybrid-optional-evidence-drawer',
+  };
+  payload.payload_id =
+    `post-attempt-review-payload:frontend-fixture:hybrid_structured_with_citation:${payload.question_identity.question_id}`;
+  return payload;

+function schemaFixturePayload(schemaFixtures, fixtureId) {
+  const fixture = arrayFrom(schemaFixtures?.fixture_results)
+    .find((item) => item?.fixture_id === fixtureId);
+  return fixture?.payload ? cloneJson(fixture.payload) : null;
+}
+
+function feedbackFixture(feedbackPolicy, fixtureId) {
+  return arrayFrom(feedbackPolicy?.fixtures)
+    .find((fixture) => fixture?.fixture_id === fixtureId) ?? null;
+}
+
+function sourceImagePostureFixture(sourceImagePosture, fixtureId) {
+  return arrayFrom(sourceImagePosture?.fixture_postures)
+    .find((fixture) => fixture?.fixture_id === fixtureId) ?? null;
+}
+
+function structuredPostureCase(structuredPosture, caseId) {
+  return arrayFrom(structuredPosture?.cases)
+    .find((item) => item?.case_id === caseId) ?? null;
+}
+
+function candidatePayloadForQuestion(adapterResult, questionKey) {
+  const candidate = arrayFrom(adapterResult?.candidates?.payload_candidates)
+    .find((item) => item?.question_key === questionKey && isRecord(item?.payload));
+  return candidate ? cloneJson(candidate.payload) : null;
+}
+
+function loadInputs(root, paths, generatedAt) {
+  const adapterResult = buildPostAttemptMsReviewAdapter({ root, generatedAt });
+  return {
+    adapterResult,
+    schema: adapterResult?.inputs?.schema ?? null,
+    boundary: adapterResult?.inputs?.boundary ?? null,
+    all3530ReadModel: readJsonInput(root, paths.all3530ReadModelIn),
+    all3530Manifest: readJsonInput(root, paths.all3530ManifestIn),
+    all3530Validator: readJsonInput(root, paths.all3530ValidatorIn),
+    schemaFixtures: readJsonInput(root, paths.schemaFixturesIn),
+    feedbackPolicy: readJsonInput(root, paths.feedbackPolicyIn),
+    feedbackPolicyValidator: readJsonInput(root, paths.feedbackPolicyValidatorIn),
+    structuredPosture: readJsonInput(root, paths.structuredPostureIn),
+    sourceImagePosture: readJsonInput(root, paths.sourceImagePostureIn),
+  };
+}

+      fixtures: paths.fixturesOut,
+      manifest: paths.manifestOut,
+      validator: paths.validatorOut,
+      readback: paths.readbackOut,
+    },
+    source_artifacts: sourceArtifactsList,
+    frontend_ui_integration_performed: false,
+    full_frontend_ui_implemented: false,
+    fixture_selection_policy: {
+      prefer_real_all_3530_rows_where_present: true,
+      synthetic_frontend_projection_allowed_when_native_state_absent: true,
+      projection_marker_required: true,
+      primary_display_source_image_only_allowed: false,
+      source_screenshot_primary_display_allowed: false,
+      full_frontend_ui_integration_out_of_scope: true,
+    },
+    native_absence_notes: [
+      'The checked-in all-3530 read model currently has real rows for provisional structured review and unavailable fallback states.',
+      'Accepted structured, source screenshot visibility, rights-blocked, rights-unconfirmed image, quality-blocked image, hybrid, and no-released-scoring-authority states are synthetic frontend projections backed by upstream policy/posture fixtures.',
+    ],
+    upstream_validation: {
+      all_3530_validator_status: null,
+      feedback_wording_policy_validator_status: null,
+    },
+    summary,
+    fixtures,
+  };
+  return {
+    ...base,
+    content_hash: {
+      algorithm: 'sha256',
+      value: sha256Value({
+        schema_version: base.schema_version,
+        summary,
+        fixtures: fixtures.map((fixture) => ({
+          fixture_id: fixture.fixture_id,
+          representative_basis: fixture.source_selection.representative_basis,
+          payload: fixture.payload,
+          expected_ui_behavior: fixture.expected_ui_behavior,
+          validation: fixture.validation,
+        })),
+      }),
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+function buildManifest({ paths, generatedAt, fixturesArtifact }) {
+  const fixtureManifest = fixturesArtifact.fixtures.map((fixture) => ({
+    fixture_id: fixture.fixture_id,
+    fixture_state: fixture.fixture_state,
+    required_state: fixture.required_state,
+    representative_basis: fixture.source_selection.representative_basis,
+    source_row_id: fixture.source_selection.source_row_id,
+    read_model_row_index: fixture.source_selection.read_model_row_index,
+    source_derivation_kind: fixture.source_selection.source_derivation_kind,
+    derived_from_source_payload: fixture.source_selection.derived_from_source_payload,
+    derivation_reason: fixture.source_selection.derivation_reason,
+    real_all_3530_match_count: fixture.source_selection.real_all_3530_match_count,
+    payload_validation_status: fixture.validation.status,
+    primary_display_mode: fixture.payload?.primary_display_mode ?? null,
+    evidence_drawer_mode: fixture.payload?.evidence_drawer_mode ?? null,
+    scoring_posture: fixture.payload?.scoring_posture ?? null,
+    source_image_visibility: fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.source_image_visibility ?? null,
+    source_asset_student_display_allowed:
+      fixture.payload?.source_asset?.student_display_allowed === true,
+    official_ms_image_student_display_allowed:
+      fixture.payload?.display_gates?.official_ms_image_student_display_allowed === true,
+    awarded_mark_wording_allowed:
+      fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.awarded_mark_wording_allowed === true,
+    source_artifact_refs: fixture.source_selection.source_artifact_refs,
+    policy_notes: fixture.policy_notes,
+    expected_ui_policy_notes: fixture.expected_ui_policy_notes,
+    expected_ui_behavior: fixture.expected_ui_behavior,
+  }));
+  const base = {
+    schema_version: MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+    generated_at: generatedAt,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    issue: ISSUE,
+    parent_issue: PARENT_ISSUE,
+    depends_on_issues: [...DEPENDS_ON_ISSUES],
+    subject_code: SUBJECT_CODE,
+    manifest_status: 'ready',
+    output_artifacts: {
+      fixtures: paths.fixturesOut,
+      manifest: paths.manifestOut,
+      validator: paths.validatorOut,
+      readback: paths.readbackOut,
+    },
+    source_artifacts: fixturesArtifact.source_artifacts,
+    summary: fixturesArtifact.summary,
+    fixture_manifest: fixtureManifest,
+    no_frontend_ui_integration_claim: true,
+  };
+  return {
+    ...base,
+    content_hash: {
+      algorithm: 'sha256',
+      value: sha256Value({
+        schema_version: base.schema_version,
+        fixture_manifest: base.fixture_manifest,
+        summary: base.summary,
+      }),
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+function check(status, id, details = {}) {
+  return { id, status: status === true ? 'pass' : 'fail', ...details };
+}
+
+function fixtureById(fixtures, fixtureId) {
+  return arrayFrom(fixtures?.fixtures).find((item) => item?.fixture_id === fixtureId) ?? null;
+}
+
+function manifestEntryById(manifest, fixtureId) {
+  return arrayFrom(manifest?.fixture_manifest).find((item) => item?.fixture_id === fixtureId) ?? null;
+}
+
+function primaryDisplayLooksSourceImage(payload) {
+  return /source|image|screenshot|official_ms_image|asset/u.test(
+    String(payload?.primary_display_mode),
+  );
+}
+
+function sourceAssetFirst(payload) {
+  return ['source_asset', 'source_image', 'source_ms_screenshot', 'official_ms_image']
+    .includes(arrayFrom(payload?.learner_display_order)[0]);
+}
+
+function candidateScreenshotsHidden(fixtures, errors) {
+  const fixture = fixtureById(fixtures, 'candidate_screenshot_hidden');
+  const ok = isRecord(fixture?.payload) &&
+    fixture.payload.source_asset?.review_status === 'candidate_only' &&
+    fixture.payload.source_asset?.student_display_allowed === false &&
+    fixture.payload.display_gates?.official_ms_image_student_display_allowed === false &&
+    fixture.payload.display_gates?.evidence_drawer_student_display_allowed === false &&
+    fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.source_image_visibility === 'hidden';
+  if (!ok) errors.push('candidate_screenshot_hidden:candidate_screenshot_must_be_hidden');
+  return ok;
+}
+
+function rightsAndQualityBlockedImagesHidden(fixtures, errors) {
+  let ok = true;
+  for (const fixtureId of [
+    'rights_unconfirmed_source_image_hidden',
+    'rights_blocked_source_image_hidden',
+    'quality_blocked_source_image_hidden',
+  ]) {
+    const fixture = fixtureById(fixtures, fixtureId);
+    const hidden = isRecord(fixture?.payload) &&
+      fixture.payload.source_asset?.exists === true &&
+      fixture.payload.source_asset?.student_display_allowed === false &&
+      fixture.payload.display_gates?.official_ms_image_student_display_allowed === false &&
+      fixture.payload.display_gates?.evidence_drawer_student_display_allowed === false &&
+      fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.source_image_visibility === 'hidden';
+    if (!hidden) {
+      ok = false;
+      errors.push(`${fixtureId}:blocked_source_image_must_be_hidden`);
+    }
+  }
+  return ok;
+}
+
+function noAwardedMarkWordingWithoutAuthority(fixtures, errors) {
+  let ok = true;
+  for (const fixture of arrayFrom(fixtures?.fixtures)) {
+    if (
+      fixture?.expected_ui_behavior?.awarded_mark_wording_allowed === true &&
+      !hasReleasedScoringAuthority(fixture.payload)
+    ) {
+      ok = false;
+      errors.push(`${fixture.fixture_id}:awarded_mark_wording_without_released_scoring_authority`);
+    }
+  }
+  return ok;
+}
+
+function acceptedScreenshotWithoutStructuredUsesFallback(fixtures, errors) {
+  const fixture = fixtureById(fixtures, 'accepted_source_screenshot_missing_structured_marks');
+  const payload = fixture?.payload;
+  const ok = isRecord(payload) &&
+    sourceImageVisibleInEvidenceDrawer(payload) &&
+    payload.structured_mark_point_posture?.status === 'missing' &&
+    ['fallback_explanation', 'unavailable'].includes(payload.primary_display_mode) &&
+    payload.display_gates?.structured_feedback_student_display_allowed === false &&
+    payload.point_judgement_allowed === false &&
+    payload.authoritative_score_allowed === false &&
+    fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.source_image_visibility === 'evidence_drawer_only';
+  if (!ok) {
+    errors.push(
+      'accepted_source_screenshot_missing_structured_marks:accepted_source_screenshot_without_structured_must_use_fallback_primary',
+    );
+  }
+  return ok;
+}
+
+function hybridKeepsStructuredPrimary(fixtures, errors) {
+  const fixture = fixtureById(fixtures, 'hybrid_structured_with_citation');
+  const payload = fixture?.payload;
+  const ok = isRecord(payload) &&
+    payload.primary_display_mode === 'hybrid_structured_with_citation' &&
+    arrayFrom(payload.learner_display_order)[0] === 'structured_feedback' &&
+    arrayFrom(payload.evidence_refs?.citations).length > 0 &&
+    sourceImageVisibleInEvidenceDrawer(payload) &&
+    fixture.expected_ui_behavior?.source_image_visibility === 'evidence_drawer_only';
+  if (!ok) {
+    errors.push('hybrid_structured_with_citation:structured_primary_or_evidence_drawer_missing');
+  }
+  return ok;
+}
+
+function expectedUiBehaviorNotesComplete(fixtures) {
+  return arrayFrom(fixtures?.fixtures).every((fixture) => (
+    isRecord(fixture?.expected_ui_behavior) &&
+    isString(fixture.expected_ui_behavior.primary_mode) &&
+    isString(fixture.expected_ui_behavior.evidence_drawer) &&
+    isString(fixture.expected_ui_behavior.scoring_posture) &&
+    isString(fixture.expected_ui_behavior.source_image_visibility) &&
+    Object.hasOwn(fixture.expected_ui_behavior, 'fallback_wording') &&
+    typeof fixture.expected_ui_behavior.awarded_mark_wording_allowed === 'boolean' &&
+    arrayFrom(fixture.expected_ui_policy_notes).length > 0 &&
+    arrayFrom(fixture.policy_notes).length > 0
+  ));
+}
+
+function manifestComplete(manifest) {
+  return isRecord(manifest) &&
+    manifest.no_frontend_ui_integration_claim === true &&
+    REQUIRED_FIXTURE_IDS.every((fixtureId) => {
+      const entry = manifestEntryById(manifest, fixtureId);
+      return isRecord(entry) &&
+        ['real_all_3530_row', 'synthetic_frontend_projection'].includes(entry.representative_basis) &&
+        Array.isArray(entry.source_artifact_refs) &&
+        entry.source_artifact_refs.length > 0 &&
+        Array.isArray(entry.policy_notes) &&
+        entry.policy_notes.length > 0 &&
+        Array.isArray(entry.expected_ui_policy_notes) &&
+        entry.expected_ui_policy_notes.length > 0;
+    });
+}
+
+function everyFixtureHasRealRowOrProjectionMarker(fixtures) {
+  return arrayFrom(fixtures?.fixtures).every((fixture) => {
+    const basis = fixture?.source_selection?.representative_basis;
+    if (basis === 'real_all_3530_row') {
+      return isString(fixture.source_selection.source_row_id) &&
+        Number.isInteger(fixture.source_selection.read_model_row_index) &&
+        fixture.source_selection.real_all_3530_match_count > 0;
+    }
+    return basis === 'synthetic_frontend_projection' &&
+      isString(fixture.source_selection.derivation_reason) &&
+      fixture.source_selection.real_all_3530_match_count === 0;
+  });
+}
+
+function upstreamArtifactsPassing({ fixtures, all3530ReadModel, feedbackPolicy }) {
+  return fixtures?.upstream_validation?.all_3530_validator_status === 'pass' &&
+    fixtures?.upstream_validation?.feedback_wording_policy_validator_status === 'pass' &&
+    all3530ReadModel?.summary?.total_post_attempt_review_payload_row_count === 3530 &&
+    all3530ReadModel?.summary?.missing_post_attempt_review_payload_row_count === 0 &&
+    Array.isArray(all3530ReadModel?.rows) &&
+    feedbackPolicy?.issue === 1435 &&
+    Array.isArray(feedbackPolicy?.fixtures);
+}
+
+export function validatePostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendFixtures({
+  fixtures,
+  manifest,
+  schema,
+  boundary,
+  all3530ReadModel,
+  feedbackPolicy,
+} = {}) {
+  const errors = [];
+  const fixtureList = arrayFrom(fixtures?.fixtures);
+  if (!isRecord(fixtures)) errors.push('fixtures_required');
+  if (!isRecord(manifest)) errors.push('manifest_required');
+  if (!isRecord(schema)) errors.push('schema_required');
+  if (!isRecord(boundary)) errors.push('boundary_required');
+
+  const fixtureIds = fixtureList.map((fixture) => fixture.fixture_id);
+  const requiredStatesPresent =
+    REQUIRED_FIXTURE_IDS.every((fixtureId) => fixtureIds.includes(fixtureId)) &&
+    fixtureIds.length === REQUIRED_FIXTURE_IDS.length;
+  if (!requiredStatesPresent) errors.push('required_frontend_fixture_states_missing');
+
+  const payloadValidations = fixtureList.map((fixture) => validatePostAttemptReviewPayload({
+    schema,
+    payload: fixture?.payload,
+    boundary,
+    fixtureId: fixture?.fixture_id ?? 'unknown',
+  }));
+  for (const validation of payloadValidations) {
+    for (const error of validation.errors) errors.push(error);
+  }
+  const allPayloadsValidate = payloadValidations.every((validation) => validation.status === 'pass');
+
+  const primaryDisplayNeverSourceImage = fixtureList.every((fixture) => (
+    !primaryDisplayLooksSourceImage(fixture?.payload)
+  ));
+  if (!primaryDisplayNeverSourceImage) errors.push('source_image_primary_display_present');
+
+  const screenshotNotPrimary = fixtureList.every((fixture) => (
+    !primaryDisplayLooksSourceImage(fixture?.payload) && !sourceAssetFirst(fixture?.payload)
+  ));
+  if (!screenshotNotPrimary) errors.push('source_screenshot_primary_or_first_display_present');
+
+  const candidateHidden = candidateScreenshotsHidden(fixtures, errors);
+  const blockedHidden = rightsAndQualityBlockedImagesHidden(fixtures, errors);
+  const noAwardedMarkWithoutAuthority =
+    noAwardedMarkWordingWithoutAuthority(fixtures, errors);
+  const acceptedSourceFallback =
+    acceptedScreenshotWithoutStructuredUsesFallback(fixtures, errors);
+  const hybridStructuredPrimary = hybridKeepsStructuredPrimary(fixtures, errors);
+  const behaviorNotesComplete = expectedUiBehaviorNotesComplete(fixtures);
+  const manifestHasRefs = manifestComplete(manifest);
+  const rowOrProjectionMarker = everyFixtureHasRealRowOrProjectionMarker(fixtures);
+  const frontendUiNotPerformed =
+    fixtures?.frontend_ui_integration_performed === false &&
+    fixtures?.full_frontend_ui_implemented === false &&
+    manifest?.no_frontend_ui_integration_claim === true;
+  const upstreamPassing = upstreamArtifactsPassing({
+    fixtures,
+    all3530ReadModel,
+    feedbackPolicy,
+  });
+
+  const checksById = {
+    accepted_source_screenshot_without_structured_uses_fallback_primary:
+      acceptedSourceFallback,
+    all_fixture_payloads_validate_against_post_attempt_review_payload_schema:
+      allPayloadsValidate,
+    candidate_screenshots_hidden: candidateHidden,
+    every_fixture_has_real_row_or_projection_marker: rowOrProjectionMarker,
+    expected_ui_behavior_notes_complete: behaviorNotesComplete,
+    frontend_ui_integration_not_performed: frontendUiNotPerformed,
+    hybrid_keeps_structured_primary_with_optional_evidence_drawer: hybridStructuredPrimary,
+    manifest_has_source_refs_policy_notes_and_projection_markers: manifestHasRefs,
+    no_awarded_mark_wording_without_released_scoring_authority:
+      noAwardedMarkWithoutAuthority,
+    primary_display_never_source_image_only: primaryDisplayNeverSourceImage,
+    required_frontend_fixture_states_present: requiredStatesPresent,
+    rights_and_quality_blocked_images_hidden: blockedHidden,
+    screenshot_not_primary_by_default: screenshotNotPrimary,
+    upstream_artifacts_passing: upstreamPassing,
+  };
+  const checks = VALIDATOR_CHECK_IDS.map((id) => check(checksById[id], id));
+  for (const failed of checks.filter((item) => item.status !== 'pass')) {
+    errors.push(`check_failed:${failed.id}`);
+  }
+
+  const uniqueErrors = [...new Set(errors)];
+  const validatorStatus = uniqueErrors.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail';
+  const base = {
+    schema_version: VALIDATOR_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+    generated_at: fixtures?.generated_at ?? DEFAULT_GENERATED_AT,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    issue: ISSUE,
+    parent_issue: PARENT_ISSUE,
+    depends_on_issues: [...DEPENDS_ON_ISSUES],
+    validator_status: validatorStatus,
+    fixtures_path: fixtures?.output_artifacts?.fixtures ?? DEFAULT_PATHS.fixturesOut,
+    manifest_path: manifest?.output_artifacts?.manifest ?? DEFAULT_PATHS.manifestOut,
+    summary: {
+      validation_status: validatorStatus,
+      fixture_count: fixtureList.length,
+      check_count: checks.length,
+      check_pass_count: checks.filter((item) => item.status === 'pass').length,
+      check_fail_count: checks.filter((item) => item.status !== 'pass').length,
+      schema_valid_fixture_count:
+        payloadValidations.filter((validation) => validation.status === 'pass').length,
+      schema_invalid_fixture_count:
+        payloadValidations.filter((validation) => validation.status !== 'pass').length,
+      real_all_3530_row_fixture_count:
+        fixtureList.filter((fixture) => (
+          fixture?.source_selection?.representative_basis === 'real_all_3530_row'
+        )).length,
+      synthetic_frontend_projection_fixture_count:
+        fixtureList.filter((fixture) => (
+          fixture?.source_selection?.representative_basis === 'synthetic_frontend_projection'
+        )).length,
+      source_image_primary_fixture_count:
+        fixtures?.summary?.source_image_primary_fixture_count ?? null,
+      blocked_source_image_student_display_allowed_count:
+        fixtures?.summary?.blocked_source_image_student_display_allowed_count ?? null,
+      frontend_ui_integration_performed:
+        fixtures?.frontend_ui_integration_performed === true,
+    },
+    checks,
+    errors: uniqueErrors,
+  };
+  return {
+    ...base,
+    content_hash: {
+      algorithm: 'sha256',
+      value: sha256Value({
+        schema_version: base.schema_version,
+        validator_status: base.validator_status,
+        summary: base.summary,
+        checks: base.checks,
+        errors: base.errors,
+      }),
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+function buildReadback({ fixtures, manifest, validatorResult }) {
+  const summary = fixtures.summary;
+  return `# PostAttemptReviewPayload Frontend Fixtures Readback
+
+Issue: #${ISSUE}
+Parent: #${PARENT_ISSUE}
+Depends on: #${DEPENDS_ON_ISSUES.join(', #')}
+Validation status: \`${validatorResult.validator_status}\`
+
+## Artifact Inventory
+
+- Fixtures: \`${fixtures.output_artifacts.fixtures}\`
+- Manifest: \`${fixtures.output_artifacts.manifest}\`
+- Validator: \`${fixtures.output_artifacts.validator}\`
+- Readback: \`${fixtures.output_artifacts.readback}\`
+
+## Fixture Coverage
+
+- fixture_count: \`${summary.fixture_count}\`
+- required_state_count: \`${summary.required_state_count}\`
+- real_all_3530_row_fixture_count: \`${summary.real_all_3530_row_fixture_count}\`
+- synthetic_frontend_projection_fixture_count: \`${summary.synthetic_frontend_projection_fixture_count}\`
+- schema_valid_fixture_count: \`${summary.schema_valid_fixture_count}\`
+- source_screenshot_evidence_drawer_fixture_count: \`${summary.source_screenshot_evidence_drawer_fixture_count}\`
+- source_image_primary_fixture_count: \`${summary.source_image_primary_fixture_count}\`
+- blocked_source_image_student_display_allowed_count: \`${summary.blocked_source_image_student_display_allowed_count}\`
+
+## UI Policy
+
+Primary display is structured/native, hybrid structured-with-citation, or fallback/unavailable. Source screenshots are never primary by default; accepted screenshots appear only as optional evidence drawer content. Candidate, rights-unconfirmed, rights-blocked, and quality-blocked screenshots are hidden. Accepted structured marks without released scoring authority use self-assessment wording and do not permit awarded-mark wording.
+
+## Manifest
+
+- no_frontend_ui_integration_claim: \`${manifest.no_frontend_ui_integration_claim}\`
+- fixture_manifest_count: \`${arrayFrom(manifest.fixture_manifest).length}\`
+
+## Validator
+
+${validatorResult.checks.map((checkItem) => `- ${checkItem.id}: ${checkItem.status}`).join('\n')}
+`;
+}
+
+export function buildPostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendFixtures(options = {}) {
+  const root = rootFromOptions(options);
+  const paths = pathsFromOptions(options);
+  const generatedAt = generatedAtFromOptions(options);
+  const inputs = options.inputs && typeof options.inputs === 'object'
+    ? options.inputs
+    : loadInputs(root, paths, generatedAt);
+  const generatedFromHashes = generatedFromArtifactHashes(
+    inputs.adapterResult?.candidates?.source_artifacts,
+  );
+  const fixtures = FIXTURE_SELECTIONS.map((selection) => buildFixture({
+    root,
+    paths,
+    selection,
+    inputs,
+    generatedFromHashes,
+  }));
+  const sourceArtifactsList = sourceArtifacts(root, paths);
+  const summary = summarizeFixtures(fixtures);
+  let fixturesArtifact = buildFixturesArtifact({
+    paths,
+    generatedAt,
+    fixtures,
+    summary,
+    sourceArtifactsList,
+  });
+  fixturesArtifact = {
+    ...fixturesArtifact,
+    upstream_validation: {
+      all_3530_validator_status: inputs.all3530Validator?.validator_status ?? null,
+      feedback_wording_policy_validator_status:
+        inputs.feedbackPolicyValidator?.validator_status ?? null,
+    },
+  };
+  const manifest = buildManifest({ paths, generatedAt, fixturesArtifact });
+  const validatorResult = validatePostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendFixtures({
+    fixtures: fixturesArtifact,
+    manifest,
+    schema: inputs.schema,
+    boundary: inputs.boundary,
+    all3530ReadModel: inputs.all3530ReadModel,
+    feedbackPolicy: inputs.feedbackPolicy,
+  });
